title: ICSC Consolidated Post Adjustment Circular ICSC/CIRC/PAC/621 (Sept 2026), post adjustment index
base: New York, December 2002 = 100 (New York itself is now 175.6, so the index is not 100 at New York). Multiplier is roughly index minus about 100 after rebasing.
notes: Index as of PAC/621; rows use their own effective date. Stations whose multiplier changed in the October 2026 memo are omitted because the memo does not publish a new index (PAC for October not yet out). Same posts as un_icsc.csv. Not used: it duplicates the multiplier for fewer stations (the October 2026 memo gives no new PAI).
publisher: International Civil Service Commission (ICSC), United Nations
